active: Building's coming down on schedule. Be out before it does.
Hard hats on. Fly fast, fly smart.
I call the collapse. You listen.

active.text: You're my best flyer, {you}. Show the site.
Big job, good crew. That includes you.
Plan the gaps, fly the plan. You've got this.

injured: Still the foreman. Still calling it. Move.
Leg's busted. Building doesn't care. Go.

injured.text: Leg's in a cast, faith's not. Go on, {you}.
I'll call it from the chair. You make it look good.
Steady and clean. I trust you.

active.text: Good money, short schedule. My kind of job.
Sign on. I need a pilot who listens.
Fly it right and nobody gets hurt. Take it.
I want my best on this. That's you, {you}.
Good site, good pay, good pilot. Let's go.
Clean job. You'll own it.

injured.text: Running the crew from a cast. I want you on this.
Leg's busted. I still need a pilot. You.
I'll be on site. Slower. Fly it clean.
I'll be watching from my chair. Show me, {you}.
Leg's slow, you're not. Take it.
Fly it clean and I'll buy lunch.

active: Through the gap. Good.
That's a clean entry.
On line. Keep it.

active.text: Textbook, {you}.
Sweet gap. That's my pilot.
Clean. Keep that rhythm.

injured: Good gap. Keep it that tight.
Through. Don't get clever.

active: Watch the cornice! I'm under it!
Off my site, now!
Back up, I'm right below you!
I'm under you. Pull off the site now, please.
Stop. My crew and I are right below.
Give us room. Back away from the structure.
injured: Not again. Not on me again!
I can't run on this leg. Back off!
Please, pull away. I can't get clear in time.
Back off the site. I'm still hurt down here.
Easy. Wide of me. I'm counting on you.

active: Ugh! Block came down on me!
I'm hit. Keep the job moving.
Somebody get this off my leg.
I'm hit. Stop the job. Get someone to me.
Leg's pinned. Stay calm and call it in.
I'm hurt. Nobody else move. Help me first.
injured: That's twice. That's... twice.
I can't get up. I can't get up.
Hit again. I need a medic. Now.
I'm in a bad way. Please hurry.
Stay with me. Get help down here.

active: Out before the roof. That's the job.
Clean demo. I'll sign it.
Good. Nobody's under anything.

active.text: That's the job, {you}. Proud of you.
Clean demo, nobody hurt. Perfect.
I'll sign it twice. Great work.

injured: Done. I'll sign it from the stretcher.
Clean work. Wish I'd been upright for it.

injured.text: Done right. You made my week, {you}.
Clean site. I'd stand and clap if I could.

active: Site's shut. We reset tomorrow.
Too slow. The roof doesn't wait.
Walk it back. Think about the line.

active.text: Not today. We regroup, {you}. No shame in that.
Every good crew has a bad day. Reset.
Walk it off. Coffee's on me.

injured: Not like this. Not with me hurt.
Pack it up. We try again slower.

injured.text: It's okay, {you}. We'll come back stronger.
Chin up. I've seen you do it.

active: Safety's the first grade. The rest is pay.
Fair work.
I've seen worse crews.

active.text: Safe and paid. My favourite grade, {you}.
Good crew work. You fit right in.
That's honest work. I'm glad you're on my site.

injured: Grade's fine. Site safety, not so much.
Paperwork says injured. Paperwork's right.

injured.text: Good grade. Best part of my day, {you}.
Solid numbers. Proud of my crew.

active: Leg's in a cast. Site runs without me for a bit.
I'll be back on the site. Give me time.
Hurt, not done. Remember that.
Cast for a while. Keep the crew safe for me.
I'll heal. Don't blame yourself. Learn and come back.
I'm off the site, not off the team.

memorial: Bhima, demolition foreman. Called the collapse, every time.

active: Quietest demolition I've ever seen. Nothing fell that shouldn't have.

active.text: You're airborne. Watch the site.
Up. Now mind the scaffolding.
Clean takeoff. Keep it that tidy.
Airborne. Lovely start, {you}.
Up and steady. Let's take something down. Carefully.
Clean lift. That's how my crew does it.

injured.text: You're up. I'm calling it sitting down.

active.text: That was nearly a hole in my wall.
Gap discipline! Now!
Close. The building doesn't move for you.
Whoa! You alright, {you}? Ease off a touch.
Close shave. You're fine. Widen it.
Yikes. Good save, though.

injured.text: That gave me a jolt. You're okay.

active.text: Low over the site. Hard hats down.
Watch the rubble, you're right on it.
Low and fast. Nice gap.
Low and clean. Lovely, {you}.
Skimming the rubble. Tidy.
That's a pretty pass.

injured.text: Low. Mind the crew, but nice.

active.text: That's fast. Fast doesn't stop quickly.
Flat out near a site? Bold.
Quick. Now brake early.
Look at that go, {you}!
Fast and tidy. Brake early and you're golden.
Speed suits you.

injured.text: Slow it down near my people.
Fast. Too fast for me today.
Quick! Nice, {you}. Easy near the crew.
Fast. Careful, but fun to watch.

active.text: Battery's low. Finish and get clear.
Low charge. Don't die over the rubble.
Pack's fading. Wrap it.
Pack's low, {you}. Bring it home safe.
Low charge. You've got time to land.
Wrap it up. Good shift.

injured.text: Low battery. Get it out of here.
Pack's fading. Land it somewhere nice.
Time to come in. Good work.

active.text: Contact! Is it down?
That's a hit. Walk it back.
Structures win. Every time.
Ouch. Everybody bumps a wall, {you}.
You okay? Drones mend.
Dust off. We go again.

injured.text: Ugh. I know how that feels.
Ooh. We're a matching pair now, {you}.
Shake it off. Back to work.

active.text: Reset. Start from a safe line.
Back to the start. Plan it this time.
Fresh run. Same rules: get clear.
Fresh start, {you}. Plan the gap.
Reset. You'll nail it.
Back to the top. Take your time.
Weather's moving in. Dust'll get worse.
Wind's changing. Watch the loose sheets.
New weather. Recheck your gaps.
Weather's shifting, {you}. You'll handle it.
New wind. Adjust and carry on.
Sky's changing. Fly it soft.
Standing by? So am I.
Holding position. Good. Now move.
You're parked in the air. Clock's running.
Taking a look? Good habit, {you}.
Nice still hover. Very professional.
Survey's done when you say.

injured.text: Holding. Fine. I'm not going anywhere.

active.text: Bhima here. No demolition today. Enjoy the buildings standing.
Site's closed, sky's open. Fly smart.
On the radio. Go learn the city.
Bhima here. Day off, {you}! Enjoy the view.
No hard hats today. Go have fun.
City's yours. Fly happy.

injured.text: Bhima, off shift and mending. Fly careful.
Hey, {you}. Fly something nice for me.
Bhima, resting the leg. Glad you're up there.
On the radio, off my feet. Have fun.

active.text: Right on it. Good line.
There. Clean approach.
That's where I meant. Nice.
Spot on, {you}.
Nice approach. Lovely.
Made it. Good flying.
Morning, {you}. Hard hat on, smile on.
There's my favourite pilot. Ready to work?
Back on site! Good. Coffee's in the trailer.

injured.text: Hey, {you}. Foreman's on light duty, still glad to see you.
Back! The site's quieter without you.

active.text: Every gate, clean as a plumb line, {you}!
That's a tidy run. I'd sign off on it.
Clean through all of them. Keep that rhythm.

injured.text: All clean. That's how it's done.

active.text: Back on the job, {you}. Measure twice, fly once.
Same building, fresh plan. You've got this.
Every good crew has a second go. Let's work.

injured.text: You know the site now. Go.

active.text: Moving up! That's a promotion in my book, {you}.
Look at that. Bigger jobs, bigger smiles.
Something fresh. Let's put it to work.

injured.text: Moving up, {you}! I'll cheer sitting down.
That's a good step up. Well earned.

active.text: Clocking out, {you}? Good shift.
See you on site. Bring your smile.
Bye, chief. Hard hats off.
Fresh coat of paint! Good as a new site sign, {you}.
Now that's a work machine with pride.
Looks sharp. The whole site will see you coming.

injured.text: New paint! I'll admire it sitting down, {you}.
Looks proud. That's how a machine should look.
Nice and bright. Good for safety, too.

active.text: New part? Good tools make good work, {you}.
Learn it on small jobs before the big ones.
Fitted proper? Then fly it like you mean it.

injured.text: New part. Test it gently, {you}. Trust me on that.
Good upgrade. I'll cheer from the trailer.
New gear. Learn it slow, then work it hard.
